execution.participant_runtime: Existing framework Python 3.11 inside sandbox-exec; not the system Xcode launcher.
execution.boundary: One fresh participant process and empty read-only working directory per active fold; no raw packet or query targets delivered to that participant. Temporary participant processes and workspaces removed before the next fold.
execution.inference: Scripted fixed probability 0.5 for every query; no model or human inference.

coverage.counting_scope: Replays are verification of the same seven sessions. Repeated training views across folds and replayed responses are not additional cases or biological units.

saved_proof.review_scope: Saved outputs and metadata only. The reviewer did not reopen authentic NPZ packets, rerender, replay, decompress or interpret image pixels, invoke a grader, read private targets, or run a model. Original packet content authentication occurred inside the admitted producer.
saved_proof.clipping_scope: Saved headers flag a cell when any plotted sample exceeds +/-2 times gain. No such flags were present; the delivered observation remains a raster, not full floating-point values.

costs.supervisor_stderr_meaning: Normal succeeded/exit-zero resource supervisor receipt, not a driver error.
costs.accounting_scope: Logical final run-directory bytes, including COMPLETE.json, not gross operating-system I/O or filesystem write amplification. Supervisor logs and independent-review evidence remain in the separately allocated lane evidence share. CPU is the observed driver/reaped-child/last-sampled-supervisor snapshot; final receipt and interpreter cleanup CPU is unknown, not zero. RSS is sampled, not an operating-system-enforced memory ceiling.

evidence.availability: Full local execution evidence is retained outside Git. These hashes identify accepted evidence; the private run artifacts and source packets are not distributed by this receipt.

remaining_limits: The seven-mouse selected, historically exposed development panel does not establish the full eleven-mouse paper or raw-imaging scope.
Calcium and behavior are jointly visible. This run cannot isolate a calcium-specific contribution or establish a causal memory claim.
ROI selection, whole-session processing, context/day order and behavior polarity remain source limitations.

The local macOS sandbox result is not Ubuntu sandbox proof or evidence of successful model image consumption.
Original equal-mouse balanced accuracy/log loss and all six fixed comparators remain unchanged and were not invoked. Competent scientific comparison and task performance remain unmeasured.
